les: Iets wat sy self klaargemaak het
kaps_punt: Leesvaardighede: lees met begrip en die gebruik van 'n woordeboek: Lees oor aktiwiteite en/of aksies wat positiewe selfbeeld bou: herroep en vertel.

items.bewering: Diep in een van die groewe het sy 'n harde dubbeltjie gekry. (die dubbeltjie as oorsaak van die pap band)
items.bron: Dictionary of South African English (dsae.co.za, 'dubbeltjie' noun 2; 'devil's thorn'): dubbeltjie is the hard spiny fruit of Tribulus terrestris (also Emex australis), found throughout southern Africa; Wikipedia 'Tribulus terrestris' and a South African cycling journal (cycleblaze.com, Durbanville to Wemmershoek) both record that the spines puncture bicycle tyres.

items.bewering: Sy het die wiel afgehaal en die band met twee bandligters van die wiel se metaalrand af gelig.
items.bron: Park Tool, 'Tire and Tube Removal and Installation' (parktool.com): hook two levers under the bead a short distance apart and pull them toward the spokes to lift the bead off the rim. (The Dutch cognate 'bandenlichter' is the standard Dutch name for the tool; the Afrikaans form 'bandligter' itself was not found in an Afrikaans source, but word choice is the language step's remit, not a fact claim.)

items.bewering: Sy het die binneband volgepomp en langs haar oor gehou sonder om iets te hoor.
items.bron: road.cc, 'Puncture repair: learn how to fix a tube': add some air and pass the tube through your hands; 'You should feel/hear/sense the air escaping.' The story's outcome (hearing nothing from a small thorn hole) is consistent with the method being one that can fail on a slow leak.

items.bewering: Buite by die kraan het sy die binneband stukkie vir stukkie in 'n bak water ingedruk. By die derde stukkie het 'n dun string borrels boontoe gekom.
items.bron: Mountain Buggy support FAQ 'How do I repair a puncture?' and general repair guides: inflate the tube, submerge it in water section by section and watch for escaping bubbles to locate the hole.

items.bewering: Sy het die band droog gevee, die plek dof geskuur en gom daaroor gesmeer.
items.bron: road.cc puncture-repair guide: 'Roughen the butyl around the hole with the small piece of sandpaper included in the patch kit', then apply the vulcanising solution slightly beyond the patch area.

items.bewering: Toe druk sy dadelik 'n lappie op die nat gom vas. ... Die borrels het op presies dieselfde plek uitgekom. (dat 'n lappie op nat gom nie seël nie)
items.bron: Road Cycling UK review of the Rema Tip Top Sport kit: unless allowed to dry properly the solution retains solvent, which impairs adhesion; Reid Cycles 'How to repair a punctured tube': leave the glue at least five minutes and do nothing else until it is totally dry.

items.bewering: Daarop het gestaan dat die gom eers dof moet word voordat die lappie opgaan. ... Sy het langs die fiets gaan sit en gewag totdat die blink kol dof geword het.
items.bron: Reid Cycles support article 'How to repair a punctured tube' (wait until totally dry) and patch-kit guidance summarised in the same search: the solution changes from a wet, shiny film to a dull, matte one when it is ready for the patch. The visible shiny-to-dull change is the correct cue.

items.bewering: Sy het die plek skoon geskuur en 'n dun lagie gom daaroor gesmeer. ... Toe druk sy die nuwe lappie hard met haar duim vas.
items.bron: road.cc puncture-repair guide: roughen with sandpaper, apply vulcanising solution, let it cure, then press the patch firmly into position. Removing the failed patch and redoing the area is consistent with this.

items.bewering: "Voel altyd eers binne-in die buiteband," ... Die punt van die dubbeltjie het nog in die rubber vasgesteek. Sy het hom met haar naels uitgetrek.
items.bron: road.cc: 'gently feel around the inside of the tyre carcass with your fingertips' and be sure all culprits are out; Park Tool: inspect inside the tyre casing for nails, glass or debris, and check the tread, since the object causing the flat may still be embedded. A thorn tip left in the tyre would re-puncture the repaired tube, so the advice in the story is correct.

items.bewering: Sy het 'n bietjie lug in die binneband gepomp en hom ingesit.
items.bron: Park Tool, 'Tire and Tube Removal and Installation': 'Inflate tube enough for tube to just hold its shape' before installing it.

items.bewering: Toe wurm sy die buiteband oor die metaalrand. Sy het die wiel teruggesit en die band eers sag gepomp. Sy het seker gemaak dat die buiteband oral reg op die rand sit.
items.bron: Park Tool, 'Tire and Tube Removal and Installation': 'Inflate to low pressure and inspect bead again on both sides', checking for an even seat before full inflation.

items.bewering: Toe pomp sy hom so hard soos wat op die band se sykant staan.
items.bron: Reid Cycles support article 'What is the correct tyre pressure?': read the pressure on the tyre sidewall and inflate to that figure; Bike Friday 'Reading the cryptic language on your tire's sidewall': tyres carry a recommended range or a maximum on the sidewall. The sentence names no number and points to the printed figure, which is correct.

items.bewering: Saterdagoggend was die band nog net so hard soos die vorige aand. (die herstel het gehou)
items.bron: Story event, not a general claim. It is consistent with the sources above: a patch applied to dull, dried vulcanising solution with the thorn removed is expected to hold (Reid Cycles; road.cc). The comparison 'so hard soos' is literal, not an analogy.

opsomming: Every step of Lize's puncture repair checks out against cycling-repair sources: the dubbeltjie as a South African cause of punctures, the tyre levers, finding the hole with water, sanding, letting the glue go dull before the patch, feeling inside the tyre for the leftover thorn, putting some air in the tube before fitting it, and pumping gently before pumping to the pressure printed on the tyre. The lesson has no superlatives and no analogies (its 'so hard soos' comparisons are literal); the only thing I could not find in an Afrikaans source is the word 'bandligter' itself, which is a matter for the language check rather than a fact.
